question: We track the accident-year reported loss ratio quarter by quarter. What is the full-year figure for accident year 2025?
final_text:
The accident-year 2025 reported loss ratio, valued at 31 December 2025, is 0.629642. This is (paid indemnity + case reserves) / earned premium for accident-year 2025, so it excludes IBNR and ALAE. The tool computes ratios as ratios of totals, so this full-year figure is not an average of the quarterly ratios.

ANSWER: 0.629642
